title: KYA-OS Handshake Request
description: Client-initiated handshake request to establish a KYA-OS session with nonce-based replay protection.

nonce.description: Base64url-encoded random value (minimum 16 bytes) for replay prevention. Each nonce MUST be unique per session.

audience.description: The intended recipient's DID. A server accepts the request only when it equals the server's DID, character for character (SPEC.md §5.2).

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds. A server MUST refuse a request whose timestamp is outside its skew window (default: 120 seconds; SPEC.md §5.2).

agentDid.description: The agent's DID. The handshake is unsigned, so this is a claim the server records, not an identity it has verified (SPEC.md §5.1).

clientInfo.description: Optional client metadata for session context.

clientProtocolVersion.description: The KYA-OS protocol version the client speaks, as MAJOR.MINOR (e.g., '1.0'). A 1.x server also reads the MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form 1.x clients send (SPEC.md §13).

clientCapabilities.description: Client capability flags for feature negotiation.
